mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the heart’s own blood vessels was most worthwhile: it showed that the heart muscle needs a supply beyond the blood inside its chambers.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying the pulmonary loop before adding conducting tissue was confusing. The electrical pathway made sense once shown, but I didn’t understand why it had to come first.

surprise.text: I was surprised that blood in the heart’s chambers cannot by itself feed all its thick muscle.

arbitrary.text: Requiring conducting tissue before the pulmonary loop felt like an unexplained ordering rule, even though the hint showed what to do next.

continue.text: I’d choose to continue: assembling the routes and discovering the heart’s separate blood supply made me curious how the circulation connects to other organs.
